inputs.text: [excited] teh… RAN… oh… don. In Greek, "pter" means wing. "An" means without. [serious] And "odon" is tooth. [curious] So what does that give us?
[happily] Exactly, a big beak without a single tooth. [proud] It lived in North America, eighty-five million years ago.
[serious] No, actually. [amazed] It's not a dinosaur at all — it's a flying reptile, a pterosaur.
